question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

123, 88, 127, 94, 131, 100, ?, 106, 139
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Logic: **Double series is followed, where (4) is added in the first series and (6) is added in the second series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/731deb4a0911897d434e04e3dd775d62da5f7ac396f762347ebb95ca725c7c85.png] 

Here, **'135'** is the missing number.

Hence, the correct answer is "135".
